def design(feats):
    import numpy as np
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, dtype=float)
    y = np.asarray(feats.y, dtype=float)
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    n, p = X.shape
    X = X - X.mean(0)
    sd = X.std(0)
    sd[sd < 1e-9] = 1e-9
    X = X / sd
    yc = y - y.mean()

    def corr(a, b):
        return float(a @ b) / (np.sqrt((a @ a) * (b @ b)) + 1e-12)

    marg = np.array([corr(X[:, j], yc) for j in range(p)])
    tmarg = np.abs(marg) * np.sqrt(n - 2) / np.sqrt(1.0 - marg ** 2 + 1e-12)
    C = np.corrcoef(X.T) if p > 1 else np.zeros((p, p))
    np.fill_diagonal(C, 0.0)

    clin = np.array([t == "clinical" for t in types])
    hub = (np.abs(C) > 0.2).sum(0)
    score = np.abs(marg) * (1.0 + 0.2 * hub) * (1.0 + 0.6 * clin)
    cand = [int(j) for j in np.argsort(-score) if tmarg[j] > 1.8]

    ci = cand[0] if cand else -1
    strong = tmarg.max() >= 3.0
    confounder_pattern = ci >= 0 and clin[ci] and tmarg[ci] >= 2.2 and hub[ci] >= 4
    if not (strong or confounder_pattern):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})

    b = X[:, ci]
    Xr = X - np.outer(b, b @ X / (b @ b + 1e-12))
    yr = yc - b * (b @ yc) / (b @ b + 1e-12)
    res = np.array([corr(Xr[:, j], yr) for j in range(p)])
    res[ci] = 0.0
    tres = np.abs(res) * np.sqrt(n - 3) / np.sqrt(1.0 - res ** 2 + 1e-12)

    cols = [ci]
    for j in np.argsort(-tres):
        if len(cols) >= MAX_DRIVERS or tres[j] <= 3.0:
            break
        if all(abs(C[j, k]) < 0.7 for k in cols):
            cols.append(int(j))

    loadings = {}
    w = {ids[j]: float(C[j, ci]) for j in range(p)
         if j != ci and abs(C[j, ci]) > 0.25}
    if len(w) >= 3:
        loadings = w
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=(), loadings=loadings)
